sources.title: unit4.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: To validate this hands-on for the certification process, you need to push your trained models to the Hub. Get a result of >= 350 for Cartpole-v1. Get a result of >= 5 for PixelCopter. To find your result, go to the leaderboard and find your model, the result = mean_reward - std of reward.
